  "memo":"Recommend clear. R08 holds because three accounts used the shipping address, but its Linkage contribution is excluded: this is the current home address, registered for 642.2239236111111 days, and the count qualifies for the household exception. No other rule condition holds, no adverse family remains, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Shared household shipping is more plausible than takeover on the available facts. Under FP-2 §6.6(c), clear is the only permitted disposition; no verification check is needed. The order has already shipped."
